_source: Battle item Basic descriptions — owned, hand-maintained. Transcribed from the in-game Battle Items screen (English) stills in screenshot-references/battle-item-descriptions/. normalize.py always uses `description` here as the Basic tier and moves UNITE-DB text to `descriptionAdvanced`; `displayName` and `cooldownSeconds` override UNITE-DB when present. No script writes this file.

eject-button.description: Quickly moves your Pokémon in the designated direction.

fluffy-tail.description: Leaves wild Pokémon unable to act for a short time and also increases damage dealt to those Pokémon.

full-heal.description: Removes all status conditions from your Pokémon and makes it immune to hindrances for a short time.

goal-getter.description: Doubles goal-scoring speed for a short time.

goal-hacker.description: Strengthens the shield and HP recovery effects of an ally goal zone for a short time when used within or near that goal zone. Nullifies the shield and HP recovery effects of an opposing goal zone for a short time when used within or near that goal zone.

potion.description: Restores some of your Pokémon's HP.

shedinja-doll.description: For a short time, it makes your Pokémon impervious to damage and immune to status conditions but leaves it unable to act.

slow-smoke.description: Creates a cloud of smoke that greatly decreases the movement speed and basic attack speed of opposing Pokémon for a short time.

x-attack.description: Increases the Pokémon's Attack, Sp. Atk, and basic attack speed for a short time.

x-speed.description: For a short time, increases your Pokémon's movement speed and prevents its movement speed from being decreased.
